title: Mushroom Stroganoff
description: A meaty-tasting vegetarian stroganoff of browned mushrooms and onions in a creamy sour cream and mustard sauce over noodles.

image.alt: Mushrooms in a creamy sauce over egg noodles with parsley

steps.text: Start a pot of salted water for the noodles. Heat the butter and oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the mushrooms and cook without stirring until browned underneath, {time 4 min}. Add the salt and cook, stirring, until their liquid evaporates and they’re well browned, {time 6-8 min}.
Add the onion and cook until soft, {time 5 min}. Stir in the garlic, paprika and flour for {time 1 min}.
Stir in the broth, soy sauce and mustard and simmer until thickened, {time 4 min}. Meanwhile cook the noodles and drain.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the sour cream. Warm gently without boiling. Serve over the noodles with parsley.

notes: A mix of mushrooms, such as cremini, shiitake and oyster, gives the best flavor.
